title: Distinguish balanced and unbalanced forces

hook.scenario: Tug-of-war mein jab dono teams barabar taqat lagati hain, toh rassi ek inch bhi nahi hilti. Par ek team thodi extra taqat laga de, toh doosri team ghasitne lagti hai.
hook.question: Yeh 'barabar taqat' aur 'extra taqat' kisi object ke movement ko kaise decide karte hain?

mental_model.intuition: Balanced forces net effect zero create karte hain, jabki unbalanced forces state of motion mein change late hain.
mental_model.description: Agar kisi object par lagne wale saare forces ek doosre ko cancel out kar dein, toh unhe balanced forces kehte hain. Agar net force zero nahi hai, toh forces unbalanced hote hain aur unki wajah se object ki speed ya direction change hoti hai.

explanation:
Nature mein koi bhi push ya pull ek force hota hai. Jab ek se zyada forces kisi object par lagte hain, toh humein unka overall effect dekhna padta hai. Is overall effect ko net force ya resultant force kehte hain. Agar net force zero ho, toh hum un forces ko balanced forces kehte hain. Balanced forces object ki state of motion ko kabhi change nahi kar sakte. Agar object rest par hai, toh woh rest par hi rahega, aur agar woh already chal raha hai, toh usi velocity se chalta rahega.

Lekin real life mein, forces hamesha perfect balance mein nahi hote. Jab kisi object par lagne wale forces ka sum zero nahi hota, toh hum unhe unbalanced forces kehte hain. Unbalanced forces object mein acceleration produce karte hain. Iska matlab hai ki ya toh object ki speed badhegi, ghategi, ya uski direction change hogi. Kisi bhi ruki hui cheez ko chalane ke liye hamesha ek unbalanced force chahiye hota hai.

Ek heavy box ka example lo jo zameen par rakha hai. Jab tum use halke se push karte ho, toh ground ka friction us force ko easily cancel kar deta hai. Yeh dono forces (tumhara push aur friction) ek doosre ko balance kar dete hain, aur box nahi hilta. Yeh balanced forces ka bilkul classic case hai.

Lekin jab tum us box ko bahut zor se push karte ho, toh tumhara force friction ki maximum limit ko cross kar jata hai. Ab push aur friction equal nahi hain, isliye jis direction mein tum push kar rahe ho, wahan ek net unbalanced force create ho jata hai. Yeh unbalanced force us heavy box ko chala deta hai. Isi wajah se kisi bhaari cheez ko push karke chalana shuru karna thoda mushkil hota hai.

key_points.title: Balanced Forces
key_points.detail: Net force is exactly zero. They cannot change an object's state of rest or uniform motion.

key_points.title: Unbalanced Forces
key_points.detail: Net force is non-zero. They always cause acceleration, changing the object's speed or direction.

worked_example.problem: A wooden block is pushed to the right with a force of 10 N and to the left with a force of 10 N. What is the net force, and what type of forces are acting on it?

steps.narration: Right side wale force ko positive aur left side wale force ko negative le kar dono ko add karo.
Dono forces equal hain isliye net result zero aayega.

worked_example.answer: The net force is 0 N. The forces are balanced.

worked_example.problem: A car engine produces a forward force of 500 N while air resistance and road friction produce a combined backward force of 200 N. Calculate the net force.

steps.narration: Forward direction ko positive maankar engine ke force aur resistance ko combine karo.
Subtraction karke final unbalanced force calculate karo.

worked_example.answer: The net force is 300 N forward. These are unbalanced forces.

common_mistakes.title: Confusing constant speed with zero force
common_mistakes.explanation: Kayi logo ko lagta hai ki constant speed se chalne wali cheez par force lagna zaroori hai. Asal mein, motion ko continue rakhne ke liye net force ki zaroorat nahi hoti; constant speed ka matlab balanced forces hain.

recall_questions.q: Can balanced forces change the shape of an object?
recall_questions.answer: Yes, balanced forces can change the shape or size of an object (like squeezing a balloon), even though they don't change its state of motion.

recall_questions.q: Can a balanced force change the direction of motion?
recall_questions.answer: No, balanced forces cannot change the state of motion or direction.

recall_questions.q: What is the requirement to accelerate an object?
recall_questions.answer: An unbalanced net force is required.

oa_questions.question: What happens when an unbalanced force acts on an object?
oa_questions.answer: It causes a change in the state of rest or uniform motion of the object, meaning the object will accelerate.
oa_questions.approach: Remember that unbalanced means a non-zero net force, which directly links to acceleration.

oa_questions.question: A block is pushed with equal forces from opposite sides. What is the net force?
oa_questions.approach: Equal and opposite forces cancel each other out.
